versions.subject: feat: add/update rules related to odbcconf (#4228)
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\odbcconf.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'odbcconf.exe'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' -f '
        - ' /f '
filter_main_rsp_ext:
    CommandLine|contains: '.rsp'
filter_main_runonce_odbc:
    # When odbcconf is run with the "/R" flag, it creates a "runonce" key to run at the next reboot
    ParentImage: 'C:\Windows\System32\runonce.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: '.exe /E /F "C:\WINDOWS\system32\odbcconf.tmp"'
condition: all of selection_* and not 1 of filter_main_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\odbcconf.exe" OR OriginalFileName="odbcconf.exe" CommandLine IN ("* -f *", "* /f *") NOT (CommandLine="*.rsp*" OR (ParentImage="C:\\Windows\\System32\\runonce.exe" CommandLine="*.exe /E /F \"C:\\WINDOWS\\system32\\odbcconf.tmp\"*"))
